scope: Read-only release pre-review of pinned EVMYulLean actual Theta/Upsilon composition and audited source-shaped replay. No claim of Ethereum/Amsterdam semantic equivalence. Exact final candidate and final build still need separate review.

primary_claims.finding: Actual linked Deposit and Exit factory Upsilon receipts derive both successful statuses and both initial journal invariants; at any listed later receipt and either kind, derives physical prequeue, exact committed effects, all three observations for each actual nested protected Theta, and projected committed log count equals retained successful-user count.

From explicit initialized invariant0, funding trace and total funding ceiling, actual preceding history states derive transaction pre-invariant/queue. Existing all3/committed effects consume the same receipt and original tree occurrence list; no per-transaction invariant or final queue/log premise.

consequential_premises.details: Factory Inputs require installed exact 69-byte runtime, sender old funding admission, factory nonce fit, distinct sender, exact recipient/calldata, entry gas>=1M, gasLimit<=2^64, explicit evaluator fuel, collision=false and CREATE2 address/preimage binding. Canonical factory installation, fixture/hash relation and source reachability are not conclusions.

Every transaction step uses actual pinned Upsilon receipt, world linkage, old TransactionFunding.Admission (sender account, upfront old gas/blob payment plus value, nonce bound, priority<=effective), calldata word fit and 5*(entryGas+1)<=fuel. This is a restricted sufficient domain, not all protocol-valid transactions.

BlockReceipt supplies U64 slot and gas, actual old r.used aggregate<=block gas, receipt list flattening and slot Nodup. It derives lifetime work<2^128 without artificial per-call iteration cap. Source Amsterdam dual-pool fees/block admission do not automatically produce these OLD gas conditions.

Literal genesis loader/full allocation total and credit ledger bound derive numeric ceiling; Counts requires pow<=2^64, withdrawals<=16*2^64, newly issued migration amount0. Ledger and actual funded history share genesis/final and total credits but theorem does not require their identical operation sequences/credit occurrence IDs. Sufficient for arithmetic envelope, insufficient to claim canonical extraction.
Full constructed balance loader supports its proven funding bound; exact canonical genesis account metadata/loader correspondence remains separate.

History allows supplied actual zero-value SYSTEM transitions with fit; this preserves invariants but does not prove mandatory schedule or normative adoption. FactorySystemSequence separately constructs same-world pair under listed inputs. Unmodelled code upgrades/retirement are outside admitted history, not proved harmless.

LocalGuarantees quantify actual nested protected Theta results at same original transaction tree. Effects separately give ordered complete retained paths, Nodup paths, exact queue replay and all-topics protected log projection. Log count is committed submissions, not final queue length after drains.

Known source old intrinsic/blob tariff/dual-pool and foreign truncated PUSH differences preclude blanket Ethereum equivalence. New checked-source terminal replay changes only old gas/fuel, preserves effects and derives synthetic Theta guarantees; actual source full world, grants, journal and occurrence identity remain open.

mathfee_recommendation: Safe strengthening: derive each uninhibited actual fee input<=2892 from the same history-produced FundedDomain invariant at that actual checkpoint, derive operational completion from actual successful user execution, then apply FeeSafeDomain.operational_quote_agrees/any_quote_agrees. Do not supply an independent numerical input bound or equate inhibited INH with a safe fee input. This is mathematical agreement conditional on actual success/domain, not universal fee-loop termination.
release_wording: For the pinned EVMYulLean evaluator, under the explicitly represented funding, deployment, resource-admission and history assumptions, both deployed runtime bytecodes satisfy the three local observations at actual protected calls and exact retained queue/log effects across the admitted histories. Ethereum/Amsterdam source equivalence and canonical history extraction are not proved.

Do not describe a same-credit numeric ledger as an extracted identical canonical credit chronology.
